title: Eval notifier orchestration for version locks and config deltas
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build an orchestrated eval-notification system that automatically schedules and routes lightweight to full-fidelity eval runs when model versions are pinned or model/config changes are applied to catalog entries or customer-locked models. The system should classify change severity, pick an eval recipe (smoke, targeted regression tests, full eval), apply sampling rules for high-volume customers, and surface deterministic pass/fail signals and artifacts to PM/Eng/Customer Success. The initial scope covers catalog updates and customer-pinned model upgrades across hosted and dedicated deployments; private (VPC/on-prem) will be supported via audit-only hooks in phase 1.
acceptance_criteria: Automated trigger fires on catalog model pin events and customer pin API changes in prod event log
Change-classifier chooses smoke vs targeted vs full eval based on delta metadata and pre-configured policies
Eval artifacts (scores, diffs, example failures) are stored in eval-store and linked in the Linear ticket and Console alert
Notifications delivered to responsible owners (PM, E2E owner, on-call) with summary and link to full report
Throttle/cost controls in place: budget per customer, max parallel evals, and daily sampling caps
Manual override mode: audit-only and notify-only phases available before enabling auto-halt on regression
updates: 2025-02-10: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Runtime, Orchestration), Applied ML, Console. Drafted problem statement and initial success metrics.
2025-02-14: Design spike complete - event-driven approach recommended (change-event -> classifier -> eval-orchestrator -> reporter). Added cost-control and sampling as must-haves.
2025-02-21: Eng proposed using existing change-event bus and adding a 'delta-summary' enrichment stage; confirmed backwards-compatible hooks for Dedicated customers.
2025-02-28: PM/Design reviewed proposed notification templates for Console and email; requested example failure snippets and clear CTA for rollbacks.
2025-03-04: Prototype orchestration running in staging for catalog pins with smoke evals; first synthetic smoke run produced a reproducible regression example for an internal model.
2025-03-05: Security/Compliance asked for data retention controls for eval artifacts; added requirement to redact PII from example payloads before storing.
design_notes: Event model: subscribe to 'model.pin', 'model.config.patch', 'catalog.update' events from change-log stream
Delta classifier: compute semantic and token-level diffs (weights metadata, tokenization profile, config flags). Map to severity scores using heuristics and historical regressions.
Eval recipes: smoke (fast latency/throughput tests + small prompt set), targeted (customer-specific prompts + sensitive metrics), full (cross-metric, multi-dataset).
Routing: high-severity changes => immediate targeted eval + notify; medium => sampled targeted eval; low => periodic batch full-eval scheduling.
Cost controls: per-customer daily budget, global parallelism cap, backoff when infra is constrained, opt-out flags for free-tier customers.
Artifact handling: store summary JSON, top-10 failing examples, diffs, and regression metrics. Redact PII and store artifact references in eval-store with TTL policy.
Console integration: quick summary card (pass/fail, delta score, top failures) and deep-link to full run; include a 'Request rollback' CTA for eligible Dedicated contracts.
Phase plan: phase A (audit-only for private), phase B (notify-only), phase C (auto-halt on high-confidence regressions with human-in-loop confirmation).
runbook: When a pinned upgrade triggers a failing smoke eval: notify on-call runtime team and PM; open a rollback candidate ticket with attached eval artifact link
If false-positive suspected: trigger targeted re-run with expanded prompt set and escalate to Applied ML for triage
If infra capacity constraint prevents evals: queue and notify owners with ETA; optional quick-scan with smaller prompt set to provide a temporary signal
For private deployments: emit an 'audit-only' event and attach enrichment payload to the customer's audit log instead of running evals by default
qa_plan: Staging harness: replay historical pin events and assert that classifier selects expected eval recipe for 90%+ of curated cases
Mutation tests: introduce controlled deltas (tokenizer change, quantization flag, config toggles) and validate that smoke vs targeted mapping is correct
Cost simulation: run synthetic high-volume pin events and verify throttling and budget enforcement
End-to-end: manual customer-facing demo with PM, Solutions, and Console to validate notifications and links
risks: Eval cost could spike if classifier is too aggressive => mitigated by daily budget and sampling
False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks => mitigate with human confirmation and multi-metric gating
Private/VPC customers may require special opt-in/out flows and legal review for artifact storage
Latency of eval runs could block release windows for customers on tight SLOs; need canary/fast-fail paths
